Review the visual design of the portal page at /support — it looks off on mobile, I want findings with screenshots as evidence

evals.prompt: I've finished implementing the Project Tracker list page in a frappe-ui SPA. The site is at http://localhost:8000/project-tracker. Run a post-build design review: screenshot the viewport matrix (1440, 1280, 768, 390), check light and dark themes, check the empty-state and loading-state, and produce a findings JSON with a score.
evals.expected_output: Screenshots at four viewports in both themes, at least empty+loaded states, findings JSON with id/dimension/severity/confidence/evidence fields, and a numeric score with letter grade
expectations: Screenshots are captured at all four viewport widths: 1440, 1280, 768, 390
Both light and dark themes are covered in screenshots
Empty state and at least one loaded state are included
Each finding has: id, dimension, severity (P0-P3), confidence (1-10), page, viewport, theme, evidence, fix
A numeric score (0-100) and letter grade (A-F) are computed from the findings
design-lint.js is run on the frontend source if the path is available

evals.prompt: Run design-lint.js on apps/my_app/frontend/src and show me the output JSON plus the score.
evals.expected_output: JSON output from design-lint.js with violations array, counts per check type, total, score, and grade
expectations: design-lint.js is invoked on the specified directory
Output includes a violations array where each item has: id, severity, desc, file, line, match
counts object shows the tally per check id
score (0-100) and grade (A-F) are present in the output
